children: Hong Kong pharma maker's interim revenue grew 14.6% yr/yr for six months ended June 2026
Net income attributable to owners rose 41.4% yr/yr for the reporting period
Gross profit improved 24.3%, aided by higher-margin products and manufacturing efficiencies
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the current quarter or full year
PRODUCT MIX - Revenue growth was driven by increased sales of licensed-in and higher-margin specialty products
MANUFACTURING EFFICIENCY - Improved product yields and cost reductions at production sites supported gross profit growth
OTHER INCOME - Operating subsidies and R&D service income contributed to higher other income
The stock recently traded at 9 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 8 three months ago
